checks.evidence: evaluate.py:186-203 resolves Hybrid/run from the joint experiment and the reviewed commit sampler; :422-449 applies the CUDA parity gate then confidence_one. resolved_findings.name: checkpoint_receipt_source_hash_field
resolved_findings.evidence: The frozen trainer writes source_hashes via _reader_metadata at train.py:228-238 and injects it into checkpoint_receipt.json at :286-289. The final validator now compares status.code_hashes with checkpoint_receipt.source_hashes at evaluate.py:109-110; its CPU fixture derives the metadata schema from train.py::_reader_metadata at test_evaluate.py:11-26 and :51-60. No other receipt-field mismatch found.

limitations: The terminal update-2048 receipt and root-created eval_input_pin.json were absent at review time; per handoff, job 607943 was still live at 530/2048. Runtime receipt validation and model evaluation remain gated on terminal completion and the verified pin.
No tests were rerun, no SSH/Slurm/GPU action was taken, and the checkpoint was neither hashed nor loaded.
